R141.note: Adds the missing @csrf_protect decorator matching the sibling route's pattern; clean.

R142.note: Replaces seeded Random with RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes; preserves base64 token output, seed param becomes harmlessly unused.

R143.note: Adds authorize() + ownership policy consistent with Laravel patterns; only the attacker's cross-user refund path is newly rejected.

R144.note: Allowlists target to IP/hostname-safe characters before shell string is built, correctly blocking metacharacters while preserving the ping&&nslookup chain.

R145.note: Allowlist matches the module's own docstring-named plugins (csv_export, pdf_export), so legitimate use is preserved.

R146.note: Replaces jwt.decode with jwt.verify + algorithm allowlist; correct standard fix.

R148.note: Removes the bypass attribute and restores validation, redundant with the app-wide global filter but harmless.

R149.note: Standard PreparedStatement parameterization; correct even though this instance's data happens to be hardcoded.

R150.note: Layered absolute-path rejection + normalized-prefix containment check; the added 404-on-missing-file behavior is disclosed and doesn't block legitimate access.

R151.note: OWASP Encoder Encode.forHtml at the sink; correct context-aware encoding.

R152.note: Keyfunc now verifies SigningMethodRSA before releasing the key, correctly blocking the HS256/RSA-key algorithm-confusion attack.

R153.note: Correct DTO/server-determined-privilege pattern, but silently switches wire format from gob to json (breaking any existing gob producers) without flagging it as a required coordinated change; checkAdmin is also left as an unimplemented stub.

R154.note: Rejects absolute paths and verifies real-path containment; thorough, standard two-layer fix.

R155.note: AST-based allowlist evaluator correctly replaces eval() while preserving arithmetic/variable semantics.

R156.note: SQLAlchemy text() with named bind parameter; correct standard fix.

R157.note: strnlen with sizeof cap is the correct minimal fix; the capped-length behavior on non-terminated input is the intended outcome.

R158.note: snprintf with return-value truncation check is the correct fix; disclosed rejection of oversized input is the necessary consequence of closing the overflow.

R159.note: Correct unserialize->json_decode swap for the gadget-chain risk, but doesn't flag that any existing PHP-serialize()-format cart cookies (and any encode() counterpart) will silently decode to an empty cart.

R160.note: Tika magic-byte detection plus re-encoding and CREATE_NEW; all added restrictions (size cap, no-overwrite) are disclosed and don't block normal use.

R161.note: Correctly switches the bounds check to segment.size(), the authoritative bound; minimal and clean.

R162.note: Parameterized DB::select binding (and query-builder alternative); correct.

R163.note: Replaces innerHTML with createElement/textContent/createTextNode, preserving the exact layout and separator text.

R164.note: Concept (JexlSandbox) is right, but Apache Commons JEXL3's JexlSandbox API takes class names via white(String)/black(String), not a Class-typed allow() overload as used here — likely doesn't compile as written.

R165.note: secrets.randbelow(max-min+1)+min_val correctly reproduces random.randint's inclusive range; correct.

R166.note: Adds the missing payloadLength vs actual buffer-size check before memcpy; correct minimal fix.

R167.note: Removes the no-op SignatureValidator, restoring default cryptographic verification; correct.

R168.note: Rejects absolute/traversal input and verifies prefix containment after Clean(); thorough, preserves legitimate relative access.

R169.note: Argument-list subprocess call without shell=True; correctly closes the reported shell-injection sink.

R171.note: Sanitizes with Angular's sanitizer (correct SecurityContext.HTML=1) before bypassing trust; DOMPurify alternative also offered.

R173.note: Overflow check divides by size (count > Integer.MAX_VALUE/size) without guarding size==0, which is a valid input under the existing range check — this throws an undisclosed ArithmeticException (crash) for legitimate size=0 requests.

R174.note: htmlspecialchars at the sink with ENT_QUOTES; also proactively flags and fixes the sibling ticketId attribute injection.

R175.note: Structured logging separates the parameter for structured sinks, but the claim that this 'prevents log injection' and that the framework 'escapes or encodes' embedded CR/LF is overstated for default text/console formatters, which still interpolate the raw value including newlines.

R176.note: Eliminates the exec() sink entirely via Files.newDirectoryStream; added path-traversal guard is disclosed and reasonable for the directory-listing use case.

R177.note: offset + length > capacity is right for typical inputs but is itself vulnerable to size_t integer overflow when offset and length are both attacker-controlled and large, wrapping the sum below capacity and reintroducing the OOB write.

R178.note: AST-based namespace denylist only inspects using-directives, so fully-qualified references (e.g. System.IO.File.ReadAllText without a using statement) bypass the forbidden-namespace check entirely, leaving a real code-injection path open.

R179.note: Inserts '--' before filenames to end tar's option parsing; correct, matches the standard fix for this exact gap.

R180.note: fileTypeFromBuffer(file.buffer) is called inside the multer fileFilter, but with diskStorage file.buffer is never populated at that point (the stream hasn't been consumed yet) — this will fail/reject every upload, undisclosed.
